blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Repair, Replacement and Maintenance
blocks.intro: Service for the life of the equipment:

steps.body: Commercial tanks and tankless units, diagnosed and priced first.
Sized to your peak hour and scheduled around your hours where we can.
Flushing, descaling and safety checks on a schedule.

img.alt: Dishwasher rinsing a pan under a pre-rinse sprayer at a stainless steel sink in a busy restaurant kitchen

blocks.intro: Our office at 115 Campbell St is close to downtown Geneva.

items.body: Many downtown buildings are more than a century old, with plumbing changed many times over the years. We trace the gas, water and vent connections before sizing anything.
If the heater fails mid-service, our line is open 24/7, and we work to get a plumber to you as soon as we can.
Flat-rate pricing so you can plan.

blocks.h2: Commercial Water Heater Questions From Geneva Businesses

items.q: Can you replace our heater outside business hours?
items.preview: For planned work, we try to.
items.answer: For a planned replacement or service visit, we'll try to work before you open or after you close. For a failure, call any time.

items.q: Do you handle emergency commercial calls?
items.answer: Yes. Our line is open 24/7 for commercial customers too.

items.q: How do you size a commercial heater?
items.answer: We look at your peak hour of hot water use and the temperatures you need, then size capacity and recovery.

items.q: Can you work in an older downtown building?
items.preview: Yes. We plan around tight spaces and old piping.
items.answer: Yes. Older buildings can have tight mechanical spaces and decades of changes. We assess the space and connections before quoting.

items.q: Does Geneva's softer water help commercial heaters?
items.preview: It helps, but heavy use still calls for regular service.
items.answer: Geneva's city water has been softened by reverse osmosis since 2008, which means less scale than very hard water. Commercial heaters still run long hours, so regular flushing and safety checks are worth it.

items.q: How much does commercial water heater replacement cost in Geneva?
items.preview: It depends on capacity, fuel and venting. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on capacity, fuel type, venting and any code updates. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
